questions.stem: How would you test whether a hydrocarbon is unsaturated?

options.text: Add universal indicator and check the pH
Add bromine water and see if it decolourises from orange to colourless
Heat it and measure the boiling point
Add limewater and see if it turns milky

questions.explanation: The bromine water test is used to distinguish unsaturated from saturated hydrocarbons. When bromine water is added to an alkene, it decolourises from orange to colourless because bromine adds across the C=C double bond. With alkanes, the bromine water stays orange.
